# Hook Doctor

Five new openings for a post, judged on whether a stranger would stop.

Use when they want a stronger hook or first line, or ask why a draft won't get attention. Not for writing a post from scratch (daily-post-ideas).

**The user might say:** "Fix the hook of this post so a stranger would stop scrolling: [paste your draft]"

## Steps

1. If they haven't shared a draft, offer one of theirs.
   ```sh
   xholic queue list --view drafts --limit 10
   ```
2. Judge the opening against the stranger test, then write five new openings yourself, each a different approach. Keep the rest of the post.
3. Check the best two or three.
   ```sh
   xholic drafts check --text "<post>"
   ```
